  Would you like to run the following command?

  Environment: local

  Reason: Разрешить второй узкий read-only запрос к той же Wiki-странице, чтобы получить только content и last_revision_id для
  live-подтверждения?

  $ PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp/wiki-pycache python3 -c 'import sys,json;
  sys.path.insert(0,"/Users/test-user/.agents/skills/wiki/scripts"); from wiki_client import WikiClient; w=WikiClient();
  slug="doc/example-doc-team/example-team-handbook/how-to-configure-a-demo-item";
  p=w.get_page(slug=slug,fields=["content","last_revision_id"]); c=p.get("content") or "";
  print(json.dumps({"slug":slug,"id":p.get("id"),"title":p.get("title"),"last_revision_id":p.get("last_revision_id"),"content_chars":len(c
  ),"content_preview":" ".join(c.split())[:240]},ensure_ascii=False,default=str))'
